attributes.name: font family count
attributes.definition: Number of distinct typeface families used for text across the page, including headings versus body.

values.definition: One typeface family is used for all text, headings and body alike.
Two distinct families, e.g. one for headings and one for body.
Three or more distinct families are used.
Not determinable or does not fit the above.

attributes.name: primary typeface classification
attributes.definition: The general classification of the main typeface used for text on the page.

values.definition: A sans-serif that is not neo-grotesque (geometric, humanist, etc.).
Not determinable or does not fit the above.
